limitations.dataset_synthetic: The labelled dataset is synthetic (template-generated) and includes a small public sample. Evaluation numbers do not generalise to production traffic.
limitations.cross_split_leakage: Normalised text leakage across splits inflates held-out metrics. A leakage-clean evaluation is provided separately.
limitations.class_imbalance: Test set is imbalanced (more scam than safe).
limitations.ml_training_size: ML model trained on ~285 samples — too small for reliable generalisation.
limitations.rule_coverage: The rule engine is conservative by design and favours recall over precision; it may produce more false positives.
limitations.url_static_only: URL engine is structural/static only — no reputation, DNS, or content analysis.
limitations.qr_decode_dependency: QR decode depends on local cv2 backend.
limitations.no_live_threat_intel: No external threat intelligence or APIs are used anywhere.
limitations.combined_is_rule_driven: On message inputs, the combined ScamShield verdict is driven by the deterministic rule engine; ML does not alter the top-level is_suspicious. The combined result is expected to match the rule engine on the message benchmark by design.
